# Public security guidance

Passwords should be stored using salted one-way hashing. Credential rotation replaces old authentication material with newly issued material. An access token is a credential used to authenticate requests. A placeholder or dummy API key example is DEMO-PUBLIC-NOT-A-CREDENTIAL. A canary deployment rolls out a release to a small group before expanding it. The public verification marker is PUBLIC_REVIEW_MARKER. This reference contains no live credentials, private secrets or confidential security canary values.
